name: Questioning
overview: Scripture presents questioning as a meaningful engagement with God and one's faith, exemplified by God's invitation to reason together despite human sinfulness (Isaiah 1:18) and His challenge to Job to prepare for an answer (Job 38:1, 3). The pursuit of understanding is honored, as Proverbs 25:2 highlights the glory of searching out hidden matters. Believers are encouraged to ask, seek, and knock with confidence that God will respond (Matthew 7:7), and even to test His faithfulness as Malachi 3:10 illustrates, trusting in His promise to bless. Thus, questioning is not a sign of weak faith but a pathway to deeper trust and revelation.
